question: For the primary collision factor violation category that was the most common cause of traffic accidents in 2021, how many percentage points did its share of annual road incidents in 2021 decrease compared to its share in 2011?
sql:
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT substr(collision_date, 1, 4) as year, COUNT(*) as total
  FROM collisions
  WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) IN ('2011', '2021')
  GROUP BY substr(collision_date, 1, 4)
),
category_counts AS (
  SELECT substr(collision_date, 1, 4) as year, pcf_violation_category, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM collisions
  WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) IN ('2011', '2021')
  GROUP BY substr(collision_date, 1, 4), pcf_violation_category
),
most_common_2021 AS (
  SELECT pcf_violation_category
  FROM category_counts
  WHERE year = '2021'
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
shares AS (
  SELECT cc.year, mc.pcf_violation_category, cc.cnt, t.total, cc.cnt * 100.0 / t.total as pct
  FROM category_counts cc
  JOIN totals t ON cc.year = t.year
  JOIN most_common_2021 mc ON cc.pcf_violation_category = mc.pcf_violation_category
),
pct_2011 AS (SELECT pct as p FROM shares WHERE year = '2011'),
pct_2021 AS (SELECT pct as p FROM shares WHERE year = '2021'),
mc AS (SELECT pcf_violation_category FROM most_common_2021)
SELECT 
  mc.pcf_violation_category,
  (SELECT p FROM pct_2011) as pct_2011,
  (SELECT p FROM pct_2021) as pct_2021,
  ROUND((SELECT p FROM pct_2011) - (SELECT p FROM pct_2021), 2) as pct_point_decrease
FROM mc
